sector_notes: The 17 KBLI categories use the codes of data/20261102_bps-province-grdp-population, where MN and RSTU are the categories BPS prints as M,N and R,S,T,U. A numbered sub-category appends its number to its category (B2 = Pertambangan Batubara dan Lignit, coal and lignite mining), and a lettered item appends its letter to its sub-category (A1a = Tanaman Pangan). TOTAL is the province's GRDP, the table's last row.

'label_raw' is each row's label_raw as BPS publishes it, and 'name' is the same text without the code a category prints ('M,N Jasa Perusahaan' is named 'Jasa Perusahaan'). TOTAL's label_raw reads 'Produk Domestik Bruto', so TOTAL is named 'Produk Domestik Regional Bruto', as var 2268 labels the same row.

Each level sums to its parent: the 17 categories to TOTAL, the numbered sub-categories to their category, and A1a-A1e to A1. Summing every row under A (A1, A1a-A1e, A2 and A3) would double count A1's items, so add up one level at a time.
Categories E, F, J, L, MN, O, P, Q, RSTU have no sub-categories.

BPS publishes no Indonesia row in these tables; the sum of provincial GRDP is not national GDP.
BPS publishes every value with 2 decimals, which the build checks; the CSV writes each value without trailing zeros, so a value BPS prints as 1.234,50 is written 1234.5.

cross_check_source.table: [Seri 2010] PDRB Triwulanan Atas Dasar Harga Berlaku Menurut Lapangan Usaha di Provinsi Seluruh Indonesia
cross_check_source.note: Perbedaan antara jumlah PDRB 34 Provinsi dan PDB Indonesia antara lain disebabkan oleh diskrepansi statistik. Triwulan I–IV 2024 dan Tahun 2024: Angka sementara Triwulan I–IV 2025 dan Tahun 2025: Angka sangat sementara Triwulan I–II 2026 : Angka sangat sangat sementara Sumber: BPS, berbagai sensus, survei, dan sumber lain.
cross_check_source.use: Annual (Tahunan) values of the 17 categories and TOTAL, compared with the SIMDASI values; its quarterly values are not used.

notes: Every value comes from the SIMDASI yearbook table of its province and year, the only source of the 62 rows, so all rows of a province and year come from one table and its sums hold. Var 2268 gives the same 17 categories and TOTAL; they match within 0.01 Rp billion, and every difference is listed under checks.cross_source.
Status is each cell's marker: * (Angka sementara) for 2024 and ** (Angka sangat sementara) for 2025. The var 2268 note gives the same status for each year.

Maluku (81) C13 Industri Mesin dan Perlengkapan is printed as 0,00 with no status marker in 2024 and in 2025, unlike every other value cell. It is written as 0 with an empty status: it is a published zero, not an en-dash cell.
Each table's change_log under source_tables is BPS's revision history of that yearbook table, kept as published; the status column follows each cell's marker, not the change log.
All 38 provinces, including Papua Barat Daya (92), Papua Selatan (95), Papua Tengah (96) and Papua Pegunungan (97), have their own table for 2024 and 2025, so the Papua split leaves no gap.

Keys whose value here differs from the sibling datasets under the same indicator code grdp_current: (12, grdp_current, TOTAL, 2024) is 1146919.76 here but 1146919.75 in data/20261102_bps-province-grdp-population and data/20261103_bps-province-grdp-2010-2025; (13, grdp_current, A, 2025) is 77911.41 here but 77911.4 in data/20261102_bps-province-grdp-population. The sibling datasets carry the WebAPI value, which var 2268 gives here as well, while this dataset keeps the SIMDASI value, so an analysis that joins them chooses one source on purpose.

Coal share of GRDP (%) = B2 / TOTAL x 100, GRDP growth (%) = TOTAL 2025 / TOTAL 2024 x 100 - 100 and sector growth (%) = sector 2025 / sector 2024 x 100 - 100, all at current prices; none is stored because all are derived. A sector whose 2024 value is 0 has no growth rate and is checked under sector_growth_from_zero instead.

checks.flags lists every value or change outside its range in checks.plausible_ranges for a person to review, and a growth flag gives the two values it compares under rp_billion; a flag stays whether it reflects a real event or a source error.

cross_source.check: SIMDASI 17 categories and TOTAL = var 2268 annual (Tahunan)
cross_source.note: BPS rounds each table separately, so the two may differ by 0.01 in the last decimal; the CSV keeps the SIMDASI value. Keys are [province_code, sector, period].

cross_source.check: status by year: SIMDASI cell markers = var 2268 note

none_or_zero_declared.check: en-dash cells the tables print = NONE_OR_ZERO_CELLS declared in the build, the same in every year; completeness expects every other key of the full grid of provinces, sectors and years

format.missing: a missing row means the source has no value; no placeholder values are written
format.layout: one value per row: key columns, then status, then value

status: final, or no marker in the source
